components.name: ai-models-litellm
components.notes: One OpenAI-compatible endpoint in front of local and external models; where egress policy is enforced.

components.name: ai-models-ollama
components.notes: Zero-egress inference. CPU is fine for Crawl; needs a GPU node for Walk latency.

components.name: ai-models-open-webui
components.notes: Fastest human-facing surface for a Crawl demo.

components.name: ai-models-vllm
components.notes: GPU required. The production-shaped local inference server.

components.name: auth-gotrue-auth
components.notes: Pair with base oauth2-proxy for one login in front of any HTTP surface.

components.name: brokers-nats
components.notes: Lightweight; JetStream gives persistence. Default broker for event-driven use cases.

components.name: brokers-rabbitmq
components.notes: Choose when you need classic work-queue semantics or AMQP clients already exist.

components.name: cloudflare-tunnel
components.notes: Public ingress without open ports.

components.name: databases-lancedb
components.notes: Embedded-style vector store served over HTTP; cheapest semantic memory for Crawl.

components.name: databases-milvus
components.notes: Heavier; needs etcd + MinIO. Reach for it when LanceDB's single-writer model is the bottleneck.

components.name: databases-mongodb
components.notes: Convenient for chat transcripts; SSPL is often disallowed in corporate packs.

components.name: databases-postgres
components.notes: Default system of record. Single StatefulSet; move to an operator (CNPG) at Run for HA/PITR.

components.name: databases-redis
components.notes: Short-term memory and rate limiting. Check the image tag against the licence change.

components.name: document-processing-docling
components.notes: PDF/Office to structured text. CPU image; slow but dependable for Crawl.

components.name: minio-single-server
components.notes: Prompts, run logs, documents. Single server has no redundancy; use a Tenant via the operator at Run.

components.name: monitoring-otel-collector
components.notes: The step from metrics-only to metrics+logs+traces; needed for LLM call tracing.

components.name: monitoring-reloader
components.summary: Stakater Reloader — auto-restarts Deployments/StatefulSets on Secret/ConfigMap changes

components.name: n8n
components.notes: Not OSI-approved; corporate packs often restrict it.

components.name: sealed-secrets
components.notes: The floor for secrets in git from Walk onwards.

components.name: security-external-secrets
components.notes: Pulls from a corporate secret store; the Run-stage mechanism in regulated packs.

components.name: security-vault
components.notes: Licence is BUSL; compliance should confirm it is acceptable.

components.name: storage-longhorn
components.notes: Not for k3d; single replica on a Pi, three replicas from Walk.

components.name: surveys-formbricks
components.notes: In-product feedback capture for forjate:ux.

components.name: workflows-temporal
components.notes: auto-setup image; use bundles/temporal-stack for the Postgres wiring.
